revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Asset name: achievement_medal_travel_tier_005
Primary request: Create one standalone watercolor travel journal achievement medal for the fifth travel tier, adventurous but still gentle.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal; uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Subject: circular cream paper medal base with handmade scalloped edge, delicate pencil outline and watercolor texture. Center elements: vintage hiking backpack, rolled map, small lantern, compass needle, dotted mountain-route line, tiny stamp shapes without symbols or text. No people, no animals.
Style/medium: cozy TripPet watercolor scrapbook collectible, low-saturation with strong readable contrast, hand-painted, fine pencil linework.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, readable in a small UI. Center objects must be visually stronger than the pale base.
Color palette: ivory base, ochre backpack, dusty teal map, muted sage details, warm amber lantern, small coral accents. Avoid pure #00ff00 in the subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
